title: MNCS owner capability map
description: Owner-native classification of MNCS tree paths for family pin coherence (consumed by mncs-actions family_coherence.py; this override wins over the orchestrator fallback). Impact lattice: executable/contract -> downstream pin must advance (REQUIRED follow-up pressure), evidence -> downstream pin may advance (OPTIONAL), docs/none -> no advancement needed. Unmapped paths fail closed to UNKNOWN and block automatic advancement.
